title: Liquidity Deep Dive Analysis

framework_lessons: Distinguish funding durability from credit quality.
assessment: Concrete successes include the April TGA sequence, 2023 gold record, uranium breakout, 24-month Bitcoin gain and Schwab profit pressure. The continuing recession lean and asserted inability to sustain positive real rates fail. Schwab equity caution did not predict its later recovery, and the optional short stop would have been reached. Insurance and bank value opinions are kept separate from horizon-defined forecasts.
